errors.evidence: The description mentions that the legend explains the meaning of each color, but it completely omits what those meanings/categories are. This is a major omission as it leaves out the core information of what each percentage represents.

errors.text_span: секторите са подредени по размер в низходящ ред
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the sectors are arranged by size in descending order. The visual order of the slices is 3%, 23%, 51%, 23%, which is not sorted in descending order.
The phrasing is grammatically awkward in Bulgarian. A more correct phrasing would be "Синият сектор е най-малък" (The blue sector is the smallest).
